channel.title: The Whimsy Corner
channel.description: A corner on the internet were a whimsy witch resides.

item.title: Many Adjustments!
item.description:
I did many adjustments to my site and fixed the lag issue!

Turns out it was becuase of my css files. I organized them so that many shared code is in one file. I also changed most of the file names for my html files to have dashes in them. I didn't get to all of them though. I have to change the names for the neopet ones but that will come at a later date.

I also adjusted the graphics collection to have each collection be on separate pages. The freeze gif script doesn't wanna work on the buttons page though so I put a warning for it on the main collection page.

I added a reference to the new mp3 player I'm using to the resources page. I made it work with widget.st but I don't have it visible. Its someone elses code I made adjustments to. I made it work with widget.st becuase I wanted the ability to use the music files I listen to without others finding a way to download them from my site instead of from the site of the song artists. I was using the miku mp3 player from widget.st but there was a character limit in the text box to put the list of songs I wanted. I had to look for another alternative.

Here is a link to the original code for the mp3 player I use.

Last thing I did was that I hooked up the source code for my website to github!

Here is a link to the source code.

item.title: New Widgets!
item.description:
I found a new site called widget.st and added some new widgets to my site!

Here is a link to the site (you will need an account).

I replaced my moon widget again because the same one was on widget.st. I have been meaning to add an mp3 player to my site but I was worried about people finding the link to the audio files and downloading them from my file hosting sites I use instead of from the original artist and I found one that hides the links. It's not perfect but I at least I can show some of the music I listen to.

My blog's comment sections have been replaced with the comment widgets on widget.st.

I also removed the visitor counter becuase I don't think its working right. I tried using the ones from widget.st but there was no option to set the starting number on one and the official one has it locked behind a paywall.

I still haven't figured out how to completely fix my freeze gif buttons. I'll see if I can find another script that does the same thing.

item.title: Spruced up About Page and Etsy Widget Test
item.description:
I made my about page less sad looking and added tabs for my favorite shows, movies, and games.

Also I found an etsy widget from this site.

There isn't much customizations I can make to it though. Im really bad at advertising stuff. I don't like ads being so intrusive and in your face and I'm not sure how I feel about having the widget on my main page. I might just turn it into a button link or something or maybe I can find a prettier widget to use and put it in a better spot. It will be there for now as a test.

item.title: Eleventy, New Blog, and RSS!
item.description:
It's been a while! I hope y'all have been doing ok!

I learned how to use eleventy, which makes coding my website a lot easier! I used petrapixel's eleventy tutorial. It was easy installing everything but setting up the templates for my website and getting it all to work right was difficult. Once I got it working though it was all good! I should be able to make pages much quicker now.

I also switched to a new blog template using Zonelets. I was also having a hard time getting things to work with my website structure. I had to adjust the template script for my needs. When getting it to work with elventy, the date part of the blog post pages kept getting deleted when I ran the elventy script. I had to adjust the post format variable in the blog script so that it won't happen.

I added an rss feed to my blog and I also found a way to style my rss feeds so now they look pretty! I won't need to use the update window anymore.

I hope y'all have a good rest of your timezone!

item.title: Switched to Using an RSS Feed
item.description:
I was using java script to load the updates from a json file previously but then I discovered about RSS feeds and how they are used. That explains the use of the RSS icons I would see on some sites XD.



I learned that I couls style them and everything too! I found this page by Benchno Kid that explains what feeds are are links some additional resources: link .



From now on I'll just use the feed to post updates rather than using javascript and a json file. I'll transfer my previous update entries over too.
